_doc: mvt1 c10 (critic A #2): sample seams and blooms inside single soft Lento cello/bass notes, placed on the c09 stems (negative values cut a bloom). c18 (critic C #3): celli 8.0 5 -> 3 dB (its bump at 8.4-8.75 rose before the sample dip; a level shape fills the dip). c33 (critic B #2): celli 176.0 re-keyed to 178.0 (v621's A-flat), refitted on the c32 stem; the +4 dB second bump removed. c57 (critic A #4): celli 178.0 bloom cut -9.5 -> -5 dB (a 12-15 dB hole for 0.4 s before the note at 180).
